title: Clark Hits Back-to-Back Threes, Fever Even Series with Aces
description: Caitlin Clark scored 27 points with 15 assists and Aliyah Boston had 22 as the Fever beat the Aces 99-89 to tie the series 1-1.
imageAlt: Caitlin Clark of the Indiana Fever dribbling in a white jersey.

title: WNBA Expansion Teams 2026: Portland Fire and Toronto Tempo
description: The WNBA has 15 teams in 2026. Here's how the Portland Fire and Toronto Tempo were built, how their first seasons went, and which new WNBA teams come next.
imageAlt: Toronto Tempo players on court against the Las Vegas Aces in Vancouver.

title: Johannes Hits the Dagger Three, Liberty Sweep the Lynx 87-71
description: Marine Johannes hit a 24-foot three, Jonquel Jones finished the and-one, and New York closed out an 87-71 sweep of the No. 1 Lynx.
imageAlt: Marine Johannes of the New York Liberty dribbling at Target Center

title: A'ja Wilson Drops 38 as Aces Roll Past Fever in Game 1
description: A'ja Wilson scored 38 points with 16 rebounds as the No. 3 Aces beat the No. 6 Fever 102-85. Las Vegas leads the series 1-0 with Game 2 Tuesday in Indianapolis.
imageAlt: A'ja Wilson of the Las Vegas Aces

title: Liberty Stun No. 1 Lynx 91-75: Game 1 Full Recap
description: Breanna Stewart had 34 points and 12 rebounds, Leonie Fiebich hit 4 of 5 threes, and the No. 8 Liberty beat the No. 1 Lynx 91-75 to take Game 1.
imageAlt: Marine Johannes of the New York Liberty

title: Dream Rally From 11 Down to Beat Mystics in Game 1
description: Rhyne Howard scored 26 with five steals, Angel Reese had 13 and 12 in her playoff debut, and the No. 4 Dream beat the No. 5 Mystics 92-77.
imageAlt: Jordin Canada of the Atlanta Dream

title: Valkyries Blow Out Wings 104-80 in Game 1
description: Cecilia Zandalasini scored 22, Tiffany Hayes and Gabby Williams added 21 and 20, and the No. 2 Valkyries beat the No. 7 Wings 104-80 despite Paige Bueckers' 21.
imageAlt: Cecilia Zandalasini of the Golden State Valkyries

title: Ionescu to Stewart Sinks the No. 1 Lynx in Game 1
description: Sabrina Ionescu assisted Breanna Stewart five times as the No. 8 Liberty beat the No. 1 Lynx 91-75. Stewart finished with 34 points and 12 rebounds.
imageAlt: Sabrina Ionescu of the New York Liberty

title: This Is the Olympics of the WNBA
description: The league pauses as Team USA heads to Berlin with Caitlin Clark, Angel Reese, Paige Bueckers, A'ja Wilson and 58 combined All-Star selections.
